# CANDIDATE: V14E_PROFITLOCK_ANCHOR5_KEEPER

**Filed:** 2026-08-24  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** exit_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The v14_enhanced_grinder sweep adds profit-lock parameters (threshold 5%, stop offset 10%) and includes an extra anchor day (5/12) to test whether profit-lock can improve edge capture by reducing give-back on reversing days while preserving runner profits on strong trend days. The edge exists because locking profits early can mitigate losses on choppy days without sacrificing much on trend days when combined with a trailing stop.

## Mechanism

Entry uses v14_enhanced_bearish_rejection_ride_the_ribbon trigger with strike_offset_bear=0 (ATM), min_triggers_bear=1, no_trade_before="09:35". Exit: profit-lock arms at +5% premium and trails stop at 10% below high-water mark; TP1 at +30% premium scaling out 50% of position; runner target at +250% premium; catastrophe premium stop at -20% (bear). All other v14_enhanced defaults remain.
